item.title: Matthews passes Mats Sundin to set Maple Leafs' franchise record with his 421st career goal
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Toronto Maple Leafs captain Auston Matthews scored twice in the second period against the New York Islanders on Saturday night to pass Mats Sundin and set the franchise record for career goals with 421.

item.title: Schaefer scores 2nd goal of game in OT to give Islanders 4-3 win over Maple Leafs
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Matthew Schaefer scored twice, including at 4:11 of overtime, and the New York Islanders beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-3 on Saturday night.

item.title: NHL roundup: Bryan Rust, Yegor Chinakhov lead streaking Penguins past Red Wings 4-1
item.description: DETROIT (AP) — Bryan Rust and Yegor Chinakhov scored first-period goals and the Pittsburgh Penguins topped the Detroit Red Wings 4-1 on Saturday for the second time in three days.

item.title: US military operation in Venezuela disrupts Caribbean holiday travel, hundreds of flights canceled
item.description: The U.S. military operation that captured Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and flew him out of the country early Saturday also disrupted Caribbean travel at a busy travel time for the region.

item.title: Amid wildfire grief, an LA-area resident sowed sunflowers and hope where her home once stood
item.description: ALTADENA, Calif. (AP) — Missi Dowd-Figueroa brought life back to the fire-ravaged plot where her home once stood -- one sunflower at a time.

item.title: Le Massif de Charlevoix shuts down because of strike, leaves tourists disappointed
item.description: Tourists looking to head to the ski slopes northeast of Quebec City were left disappointed after a resort along the St. Lawrence River suspended operations when its unionized workforce walked off the job.

item.title: Carney says Canada 'welcomes the opportunity for freedom' after Maduro's capture
item.description: TORONTO — The daring ouster of the president of Venezuela by the U.S. military sent shockwaves through the Western Hemisphere as President Donald Trump heralded the operation in the oil-rich Latin American nation a success.

item.title: Minten scores in overtime, Boston Bruins top Vancouver Canucks 3-2
item.description: VANCOUVER — Fraser Minten scored with 19 seconds left in overtime and the Boston Bruins edged the Canucks 3-2 in Vancouver on Saturday.

item.title: Lights back on for First Nation in Manitoba, but frozen water poses new threat: chief
item.description: The chief of a First Nation in Manitoba says about 4,000 residents haven't been able to return to the community and dozens more are set to leave because its water system has frozen after a days-long power outage.
